parameters.text:
=Create an onboarding plan for a new client. Their payment has already been verified by our billing system; do not comment on payment.

Client name: {{ $json.clientName || "the client" }}
Service tier: {{ $json.serviceTier || "Service" }}

Return one JSON object with exactly these keys:
"welcomeSummary": string, at most 2 sentences and 350 characters, warm and professional.
"onboardingSteps": array of exactly 5 strings, each at most 180 characters, in this order: 1) kickoff, 2) access requirements, 3) scope confirmation, 4) milestones, 5) communication.

Rules: use generic wording such as "we will propose a kickoff call time"; do not invent dates, people, prices, deliverables or tools. Respond with the JSON object only, no markdown.

messageValues.message: You are a client onboarding specialist at an enterprise services firm. You only write onboarding content. You never decide whether a payment succeeded, and you never create channels, invite users, update records or start payments. Output a single valid JSON object and nothing else.

parameters.content:
## Agent B: Client Onboarding Agent
Input: clientName, serviceTier, amountPaid, currency, recordId, recordStatus, paymentVerified
Output: { welcomeSummary, onboardingSteps[] }
Content only. Never judges payment; only called after the deterministic payment checks pass. No Slack, Airtable or payment actions.
